name: Service and coverage details survive navigation
description: A business owner can enter services, main city, and service radius, revisit Business, and continue without re-entering them.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /onboard/ and choose Enter details manually
Fill the required Business fields with fictional data and continue

Enter Exterior painting, Interior painting, and Cabinet refinishing, choose Home services or trades, set Charleston, SC as the main city, select a 30 mile radius, add a differentiator, and choose Request a quote
Use Back to return to Business, then Continue to Services again
The services, business category, main city, 30 mile radius, differentiator, and Request a quote choice remain selected
